entry_points.summary: Maps role->expected_contract: consultant_primary/secondary->freeform, reviewer->review-verdict, implementer->None, ideator->None. Single source of truth for known roles in validate, random-for-role, random-distinct-for-role.
resolve <command> <role>: resolve persona/model/runtime triple from merged TOML config; emits chimera event when axes come from >=2 layers.
Print JSON array of {name, source_layer, path} -- winner per name only; emits persona_shadowed on collisions.
Validate all bound personas exist, compatible_roles are known, and contract matches role expected_contract (T009). Exits 1 on any violation.
Print all layer paths defining a named persona in load order; exits 1 if not found.
Print frontmatter + body of the winning persona file for a given name.
Emits persona_shadowed once per (process, name) for each name defined in more than one layer.
Emits persona_binding_chimera once per (process, command, role) when persona/model/runtime axes come from >=2 config layers.
Shared stdlib-only frontmatter parser and portability header builder used by all four per-target persona_export.py modules.

[rotation] random-for-role <role> [--exclude=<ids>] [--seed=<s>]: enumerate compatible personas (including boring-anchor, T102), prepend no-persona sentinel, apply --exclude, draw uniformly, emit persona_random_selected (selection_source=random_role_pool), return resolve-shaped JSON + {selection_source, draw_id, candidates}. Empty pool -> boring-anchor tagged fallback_empty_pool.

[ideator] random-distinct-for-role <role> --count=<N> [--exclude=<ids>] [--seed=<s>]: draw up to N distinct personas without replacement, EXCLUDING boring-anchor and no-persona. Returns JSON array of resolve-shaped objects. Underflow returns shorter array (or []) and notes on stderr, exits 0. Each pick emits persona_random_selected with selection_source=random_role_pool_distinct sharing one draw_id. Backs /z-brainstorm ideator diversity (brainstorm.personas knob).

[rotation] forced-control <role> [--arm=boring-anchor|no-persona]: return control arm tagged selection_source=forced_control. Default arm boring-anchor. Emits persona_random_selected. Used on the cadence-Nth attempt as a floor guarantee.

[rotation] control-counter --increment: atomically read+increment+persist the per-repo forced-control cadence counter in .z-harness/.persona-control-counter (flock-guarded). Returns new counter value.

[rotation] String constant "boring-anchor" -- the control persona. In random pool (T102); also drawn on forced-control cadence as floor. fallback_empty_pool draws are quarantined. EXCLUDED from random-distinct-for-role pool.

[rotation/ideator] String constant "no-persona" -- reserved null baseline sentinel. No disk file; persona_body_path=null. Always prepended to random-for-role pool; EXCLUDED from random-distinct-for-role pool. Primary delta baseline in persona-stats.py.

[rotation] Hardcoded candidate dict for no-persona: {name, source_layer, path=None, _fm={}}. Injected at head of candidate list by cmd_random_for_role before disk enumeration. Never injected by cmd_random_distinct_for_role.
[rotation] String constant "no-persona" used as the primary per-stratum delta baseline in build_report(). Replaces boring-anchor as the primary baseline (T104).
[rotation] Build stratified report: resolves per-stratum baseline as no-persona first, boring-anchor second, None third. Emits delta_vs_baseline and baseline_source per group.

invariants: Persona/model/runtime are orthogonal axes -- persona controls the prompt prefix, model controls which LLM is called, runtime controls the dispatch target. None implies the others.
Layer load order is builtin < user-global < repo-local; last definition wins per name. Shadowing emits persona_shadowed once per (process, name).
persona_shadowed is de-duped by module-level _shadowed_emitted set keyed on name alone (not layer pair) -- fires once per process per shadowed name.

persona_binding_chimera fires when the three binding axes (persona, model, runtime) originate from two or more different config layers for the same (command, role) pair; de-duped per (process, command, role).
compatible_roles mismatch at bind time is a soft warning only -- it emits a persona_compat_warning event but does NOT block resolution.
contract mismatch between a bound persona contract field and the role expected_contract (from _ROLE_REGISTRY) is a hard error -- cmd_validate exits 1.
Persona name must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ with no trailing hyphen; validated on frontmatter parse, exits 2 on violation.
Unknown frontmatter keys cause exit 2 -- model/runtime belong in TOML config, not in the persona file.

Orchestrator (not dispatcher) calls resolve-persona.py, reads persona_body_path, and calls prepend_persona before Dispatcher.run -- the dispatcher accepts an already-composed prompt and performs no persona resolution internally.
persona_bound source field is a per-axis nested dict {persona: <layer>, model: <layer>, runtime: <layer>} where each layer value is one of: override, provider_config, none.
persona_bound, persona_override_used, and model_resolved payloads use the field name `command` (not `command_id`) as of T103.
Dispatcher.run accepts role: str | None = None kwarg; when provided, included in persona_bound payload but not used for resolution.

_ROLE_REGISTRY contains exactly five roles: consultant_primary (freeform), consultant_secondary (freeform), reviewer (review-verdict), implementer (None), ideator (None). ideator contract=None means any persona contract (or no contract) is accepted.

[ideator] random-distinct-for-role EXCLUDES boring-anchor and no-persona from its pool -- the subcommand draws only real content personas for brainstorm diversity. This is opposite to random-for-role which INCLUDES both.
[ideator] random-distinct-for-role draws without replacement (rng.sample). Underflow (pool smaller than count) returns a shorter array and exits 0 -- NEVER exits non-zero on underflow.

[ideator] Each persona picked by random-distinct-for-role emits one persona_random_selected event with selection_source=random_role_pool_distinct. All picks from the same call share one draw_id (computed once before the loop).

[ideator] 8 builtins carry compatible_roles: [..., ideator]: pattern-oracle, anti-consensus-surgeon, cut-it-half, brutalist-architect, biomimetic-architect, physics-reductionist, fossil-whisperer, cobol-greybeard. Personas with contract: review-verdict are excluded from the ideator pool by contract-compatibility filtering (ideator role has expected_contract=None but review-verdict personas can still be filtered by /z-brainstorm dispatch logic -- confirm with brainstorm source if needed).

[rotation T102 AMENDED -- REVERSES PRIOR INVARIANT] boring-anchor IS now a member of the random_role_pool and can be drawn stochastically. The forced_control cadence (every experiment.control_every_n attempts) is a FLOOR guarantee for minimum boring-anchor samples, not the only path. selection_source distinguishes a random_role_pool draw (may be boring-anchor) from a forced_control cadence draw (always boring-anchor).

[rotation] no-persona is a reserved sentinel (persona_id="no-persona", persona_body_path=null) representing the vanilla implementer with zero prompt prefix. It is always prepended to the random candidate pool by random-for-role before disk enumeration (unless --excluded). A no-persona draw emits persona_random_selected + persona_attempt_outcome with persona_id="no-persona" -- it is a tracked baseline arm, NOT the same as knob-off (experiment.persona_rotation=false, which emits nothing).

[rotation] _enumerate_role_compatible_personas filters out any disk file named no-persona.md so the hardcoded _NO_PERSONA_SENTINEL is the only source of no-persona draws. No disk file can produce a no-persona candidate.

[rotation] persona-stats.py resolves the per-stratum delta baseline as: (1) no-persona [primary, when stratum has >=1 no-persona sample], (2) boring-anchor [secondary, when stratum has 0 no-persona samples], (3) None [no delta reported]. Both no-persona and boring-anchor appear as normal tracked arms. fallback_empty_pool draws are quarantined and never enter any baseline.

[rotation] persona_random_selected is emitted BEFORE the agent runs (at draw time), not at dispatch time. draw_id is the join key between this event and persona_attempt_outcome. Optional join fields task_id, attempt_id, persona_id are stamped on the payload when the corresponding env vars are exported at dispatch time.

[rotation] persona_attempt_outcome is emitted by the ORCHESTRATOR at attempt close (not by resolve-persona.py). TRUE terminals that trigger it: done (success or proceed-anyway), unable_to_complete, abandoned, test_failed, halt (forced no_ask). NEVER emitted on needs_clarification, decision_needed, or spec_problem -- those are PAUSES that resume the same attempt with the same persona. Only emitted when experiment.persona_rotation=true.

[rotation] persona_bound extended payload for rotation: adds {run_id, command, role, task_id, attempt_id, persona_id, model, runtime, selection_source, draw_id} plus existing per-axis source. reviewer events additionally carry reviewer_participant in {base_codex, random_arm}.
[rotation] attempt_id = <task_id>-v<cycle>. Resume = same cycle -> same attempt_id -> reuse persona-draw.json. Retry = cycle incremented -> new attempt_id -> new draw.
[rotation] selection_source enum: random_role_pool | random_role_pool_distinct | forced_control | fallback_empty_pool | fixed_panel
[rotation] control-counter subcommand increments .z-harness/.persona-control-counter atomically (flock-guarded). Returns new counter value. Called once per fresh implementer attempt.
gotchas: _shadowed_emitted is keyed on name only (not on layer pair), so if a persona appears in all three layers, persona_shadowed still fires exactly once per process for that name.
persona_binding_chimera is keyed on (command, role), not on the specific axis combination -- if the same (command, role) binding is evaluated twice, the event fires only once.
cmd_validate checks compatible_roles only against known role names in _ROLE_REGISTRY -- a compatible_roles entry for an unknown role is a validation error, not silent.

persona file body (the prompt prefix) is everything after the closing '---' delimiter; a leading blank line is stripped by _persona_utils.parse_persona_file but the script-side _parse_frontmatter does not strip it.

prepend_persona strips YAML frontmatter using a simple string search for '
---
'; if the closing delimiter is missing, the entire file (including frontmatter) is treated as the body.

Layer 3 (repo-local) path uses git rev-parse to find repo root; falls back to cwd if git is unavailable. Z_HARNESS_REPO_ROOT, Z_HARNESS_REPO_PERSONAS_DIR, Z_HARNESS_BUILTIN_PERSONAS_DIR, and Z_HARNESS_USER_PERSONAS_DIR all override the respective layer paths for hermetic testing.
resolve-persona.sh is a thin bash wrapper -- all logic lives in resolve-persona.py; the shell script exists solely so dispatch sites do not need to know the Python path.

Dispatcher.run() role kwarg is informational only -- it appears in persona_bound but does not trigger any resolution or validation; the caller is already responsible for resolving the role before calling run().
[rotation] random-for-role exits 2 on unknown role (not in _ROLE_REGISTRY). Add to _ROLE_REGISTRY before calling.
[rotation] random-distinct-for-role also exits 2 on unknown role. Add ideator (or any new role) to _ROLE_REGISTRY before calling either subcommand.
[rotation] fallback_empty_pool always returns boring-anchor body; this is NOT a forced_control sample and must NOT be counted as boring-anchor baseline in analysis.

[rotation] boring-anchor bypasses compatible_roles and contract checks in _enumerate_role_compatible_personas (treated as multi-role/any). It is included in the pool for any role -- BUT is explicitly excluded by cmd_random_distinct_for_role before calling _enumerate_role_compatible_personas.

[rotation] A no-persona.md file in any layer is silently filtered out by _enumerate_role_compatible_personas -- it cannot contribute a disk-backed candidate entry. Only the hardcoded _NO_PERSONA_SENTINEL can produce a no-persona draw.

[rotation] no-persona and boring-anchor both have delta_vs_baseline=None for their own rows (a baseline arm is never compared against itself). baseline_source in the output indicates which arm was used.

[rotation] reviewer dual-dispatch: both base_codex and random_arm share attempt_id; each has its own draw_id. ONE persona_attempt_outcome per attempt. Analysis groups reviewer rows by reviewer_participant (many-to-one).
[rotation] persona-draw.json records {attempt_id, persona_id, draw_id, selection_source, persona_body_path}. Orchestrator checks attempt_id field to detect resume vs retry.

[ideator] brainstorm.personas knob defaults ON. When OFF, the entire 2a block in /z-brainstorm is a no-op -- no draw, no prefix, no persona_bound event. The ideator dispatch is byte-identical to the pre-persona vendor-only brainstorm.

[ideator] /z-brainstorm binds the returned personas positionally: first element -> claude ideator, second -> codex ideator, third -> gemini ideator. Unfilled slots run vanilla and record <none> in ideator_personas frontmatter.
